title: Where Will The Relief Come From?
gist: Gavekal admits its recent late-cycle trade ideas (metals, miners, EM debt, Hong Kong real estate and equities) have been 'total duds' except Indian equities, as metals melted down (silver -1/3) and gold tracked tech stocks lower. Combined with sell-offs in crypto, the Nikkei, the Kospi, Brazil and EM currencies, markets look unhealthy; the teaser asks what is driving the unraveling and where relief will come from.

insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Shows a coherent late-cycle playbook (lower yields + AI capex stall + cheaper energy) that the market has so far refused to reward.
